output.explanation: Expanded surfaces because its two renderer-owned runtimes hide substantial internal composition. The central diagram now shows mounted ownership and teardown; editor-adapter expands checkpoint synchronization, subscriptions and gesture commits, while renderer-models expands reactive projections, gesture ownership, anchors and routing. Their shared selection-ownership object is connected explicitly. Left workspace, sessions, domain and backend unchanged; moved backend only to make room. Checked the pinned checkout's page composition, session construction, editor adapter, runtime, selection tools, anchor store and routing store. Source confirms that SourceWindowPanel is a sibling and sessions/controllers are borrowed. Added source-verified qualifications: native selection tracks dragging rather than application membership, and clearing the renderer's editor reference disposes routing resources. Preserved every existing edge, relocating surface endpoints where their concepts moved.

MappingEditorRuntime: native editor / semantic controller adapter
src/features/mapping/tldraw/MappingEditorRuntime.ts
|
|-- Borrowed collaborators: Editor + session.controller
|   `-- NativeSelectionOwnership supplied by CanvasRuntime.gestures
|-- Adapter state
|   |-- projected: node ID -> last projected shape
|   |-- checkpoint: canvasRevisionId mirrored in editor document metadata
|   `-- syncing / settling / navigating / dirty / pendingProjection flags
|-- Subscription/disposer registry
|   |-- Attached controller driver: settle + undo callbacks
|   |-- Controller subscription -> publish relevant snapshot changes
|   |   `-- writeShapes(): create/update/delete; project application selection
|   |-- Editor document side effect: changed mappingCheckpoint
|   |   `-- -> controller.restoreEditorCheckpoint(); republish without recording
|   |-- Editor store observer: shape/selected-shape edits -> dirty
|   `-- Idle editor tick -> settle dirty geometry, then pending projection
|-- hydrate()
|   `-- -> controller.editorHistory(); replay checkpoint IDs into native undo
|       `-- Materialize current shapes; historical geometry restored lazily
|-- settle()
|   |-- Compare native shapes with projected cache
|   |   |-- Grid movement / supported Alt-drag copies -> semantic operations
|   |   `-- Floating pane geometry -> updated display state
|   |-- Native selection updates dragDiagramIds, NOT application membership
|   `-- Changed geometry -> controller.commitEditorGesture(moves, canvas)
|-- undo(redo)
|   |-- Complete and settle editor, then native undo/redo
|   `-- Transfer transaction boundary -> reject; workspace must coordinate
`-- dispose()
    `-- Complete + settle; detach driver and subscriptions in reverse order

CanvasRuntime: renderer-owned projection and interaction state
src/features/mapping/tldraw/CanvasRuntimeContext.tsx
|
|-- Borrowed session + controller; optional Editor atom
|   `-- connect() -> controller.subscribe(sync); caller owns unsubscribe
|-- SelectionToolBridge
|   |-- NativeSelectionOwnership: application/native gesture arbitration
|   `-- Gesture handlers used through editor -> bridge WeakMap
|-- Per-ID Models<T>
|   |-- grids: diagram, view, frame, selected content and layoutKey
|   |-- floats: pane ancestry, stale/missing/visible state
|   |-- panels: side-panel projections + cell size
|   |-- edges: connection + resolved shape-local endpoints
|   `-- Model atoms: publish() structurally shares equal branches
|-- Projection cache: previous snapshot + display-node registry + edge IDs
|   `-- sync(): derive models; retain valid anchors; synchronize routing owners
|-- LocalAnchorStore
|   |-- Endpoint-keyed atoms: {layoutKey, rect}
|   |-- Measurements supplied by useLocalAnchors; rounded shape-local rectangles
|   `-- Layout changes invalidate; DOM culling/camera movement do not
|-- NativeRoutingStore
|   |-- Obstacle owners + layout-keyed measurement atoms
|   |   `-- World obstacles use native shape transforms, not camera transforms
|   |-- ConnectionRouter + last settled routes
|   |-- Worker state: one in-flight job + newest pending job
|   |   `-- Accept only current request; failure -> synchronous router fallback
|   `-- drawAll(): drag/pending previews; matching completed routes when ready
|-- routedEdges computed
|   `-- Edge models + anchors + live native geometry -> routing.drawAll()
|-- Focused edge/node atoms + computed node connections
|-- Interaction / catalog / alternative / undo / escape atoms
|-- CanvasActions callbacks installed by application command UI
|   `-- Undo, escape, jump, collapse, pane and conversation actions -> callers
`-- Editor reference cleared on teardown -> routing.dispose() terminates worker
